role: Healthcare SMB Outbound Sales Development Representative

hero.label: Made for Syntra
hero.headline: I want to help Syntra bring AI auditing to every healthcare SMB.
hero.subheadline: Real-time AI chart and claim auditing is exactly the kind of product that changes how an entire industry operates, and Syntra is building it at the right moment. I want to be the person making the first calls that bring that technology to the SMBs who need it most. This is the role I have been building toward.

whyCompany.title: Healthcare revenue cycle is broken and Syntra is fixing it in real time
whyCompany.body: Claim errors and compliance gaps cost healthcare providers billions every year, and most SMBs have no automated way to catch them before they become denials or audits. Syntra's AI agents sitting directly in the chart and claim workflow is a fundamentally different approach than legacy auditing software. That kind of clear, demonstrable ROI makes outbound conversations much easier to start and much faster to close.

whyCompany.title: Early SDR hire means building the outbound playbook from the ground up
whyCompany.body: Joining at this stage means the sequences, messaging, and ICP targeting I build will shape how Syntra does outbound for years. That is not a supporting role, it is a foundational one. I thrive in environments where the work I do today becomes the system everyone else uses tomorrow.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and B2B marketing background maps directly onto this motion
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped the company land 15 to 20 paying clients in just over a year. At NextAfter I spent a summer inside a B2B consultancy learning how buyers evaluate and adopt new solutions, which sharpened how I think about positioning in outbound messaging. Selling an AI product with a clear compliance and revenue ROI to healthcare SMBs is exactly the kind of consultative outbound motion I have been training for.

quote: I have spent the last year learning that the best outbound is really just helping the right buyer see a problem they already have. Syntra's product makes that conversation almost automatic, and I want to be the one having it.
